task_title: 코드와 번들 데이터의 출처·license·third-party notices·SBOM·dependency/security scan을 수행한다
seed: not applicable: the inputs are the tracked tree and the installed metadata
backend: cpu; no simulation and no CUDA context

physics_configuration.generator: scripts/provenance_inventory.py run with the development interpreter; --check compares its stable sections (project, components, assets, open_items, history_note) with the committed docs/validation/sbom.json and regenerates docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md from the committed SBOM
physics_configuration.pip_closure: every distribution reachable from [project].dependencies and every optional-dependencies group of pyproject.toml through Requires-Dist with environment markers evaluated for this interpreter
physics_configuration.non_pip_assets: the hand-maintained ASSETS table of the generator: frontend bundle libraries with versions from package-lock.json, fonts, material tables, own artwork, manuscript, validation records, reference outputs of other solvers, application records, examples and fixtures, and the three vendor-derived items
physics_configuration.scan_inputs: every tracked path from git ls-files except binaries and the four files that spell the patterns; positions only, never the matched text
physics_configuration.pattern_samples: fourteen positive and nine benign strings in tests/test_provenance_inventory.py, assembled at run time with synthetic addresses and parametrized under short labels so that no sample reaches a test id or a JUnit report
physics_configuration.history_query: git log --pickaxe-regex -S'C:[/\\]+Users[/\\]+admin' HEAD, keeping the commits whose tree still contains the pattern
physics_configuration.dependency_check: python -m pip check in the same interpreter
physics_configuration.vulnerability_audit: pip-audit -r <pinned closure> --no-deps, recorded in the SBOM when run with --audit and carried forward otherwise

reference_method: pyproject.toml as the list of declared dependencies; package-lock.json as the frontend version reference; docs/RELEASE_REVIEW.md as the list of unresolved distribution items; the pattern samples as the scan oracle

observables.name: findings
observables.definition: scan findings on the tracked tree

observables.name: components
observables.definition: distributions in the closure and how many are installed with a licence label and a source URL

observables.name: open_items
observables.definition: items with BLOCKED_EXTERNAL semantics in the SBOM and the notices

observables.name: history_commits
observables.definition: commits on HEAD whose tree contains the historic workstation path

observables.name: audit_status
observables.definition: pip-audit status recorded in the SBOM: CLEAN, FINDINGS, NOT_RUN or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL

acceptance_limits.check: --check exits 0 with no finding and no problem on the committed tree, and pip check exits 0
acceptance_limits.coverage: every declared dependency of pyproject.toml appears in the SBOM installed with a version and a source URL, and with a licence label or an open item; every asset in the table has a status among cleared, own and open; three.js and lucide versions match package-lock.json
acceptance_limits.open_items: the installed-API property catalogue, the FSP layout support and the aggregate commercial timing table are open items with state BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and appear in the notices document; nothing with an unclear licence is omitted
acceptance_limits.scan: each positive sample matches its pattern and no benign sample matches any pattern; the generated SBOM and notices match no pattern and contain no venv, site-packages or Hangul account path
acceptance_limits.history: the commits that carry the historic workstation path are listed in the notices as a known history note and are not counted as findings
acceptance_limits.audit: the pip-audit result is recorded as a statement about the development interpreter with fix versions; advisories do not fail --check, which is the G9-06 release-environment concern
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: the brief of G9-02 in docs/COMPLETION_PROGRAM_KO.md section 11 and docs/RELEASE_REVIEW.md

applicable_scope: G9-02 provenance inventory of the tracked tree and of the development interpreter's dependency closure per docs/validation/cases/G9-02.json; the three vendor-derived items are open BLOCKED_EXTERNAL items for G9-03, and the advisories describe the development interpreter, not a release environment (G9-06)
note: pip-audit 2.10.1 was installed into D:/TorchFDTD/.venv for this task and run once with --audit on 2026-09-22: 7 of the 51 closure distributions carry advisories in the development interpreter (anyio, click, fonttools, idna, pillow, starlette, tqdm; fixes listed in docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), torch 2.10.0+cu126 could not be audited on PyPI; pip check found no broken requirement
verification_reason: no failures or errors, and no required test skipped or absent

null_reasons.observed_metrics: no observed-metrics file was supplied; the JUnit pass/fail record is the only measurement
null_reasons.package_or_wheel_sha256: no distribution file was supplied; the evidence applies to the source tree at source_commit
